caption: Roman Forum, Rome
composition: Via Sacra ruins toward temples and arch · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: Walking the ancient Via Sacra, the tourist looks down the worn basalt road into the Forum's ruins, with the tall columns of a temple portico rising right and a triumphal arch standing center-frame. Rows of broken columns stretch to the left toward the Palatine, where umbrella pines and ochre palazzi crown the hill. The 07:18 sun rakes low and golden across the stone, throwing long shadows down the old road.
